Change c0471. Location: 1818 Vol. III, Ch. VI; 1831 Ch. XXIII.

Context before (unchanged): It is your duty as a magistrate, and I believe and hope that your feelings as a man will not revolt from the execution of those functions on this occasion."

1818 text: This address caused a considerable change in the physiognomy of my auditor.

1831 text: This address caused a considerable change in the physiognomy of my own auditor.

Diff: This address caused a considerable change in the physiognomy of my {+own+} auditor.

Context after (unchanged): He had heard my story with that half kind of belief that is given to a tale of spirits and supernatural events; but when he was called upon to act officially in consequence, the whole tide of his incredulity returned.

result.rationale: Adds the single word "own" before "auditor" ("my own auditor"), a minor stylistic emphasis on possession with no change to events or character; meaning essentially unchanged.
